verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for self-hosted server software like Keycloak, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no vendor telemetry or usage tracking, and no switch to disable one. The metrics and OpenTelemetry guides cover operator-configured observability that the admin collects for their own use. That is an adjacent feature, not an opt-out from vendor usage tracking, so it earns no credit.
